notes: Same harness, scenarios and assertions as iteration 1. Skills at skill-snapshot-v2 (commit 00e1b86). n=1 per configuration, so treat differences as directional. Ran locally on macOS (CLI 2.1.292) with the host CLAUDE.md disabled.

Incremental pass rate went from 91% to 96.5%. RL incremental is 26/26 (it 1: vendor leak). Quant incremental is 26/28: its only failures are brief size and goal count, the brief-goal issue deliberately left to the roadmap design. The final architecture is Approved, the spec is vendor-free, and no turn drafts two layers.

Doc growth is cut but not gone. Quant incremental went from 42.0k to 32.0k words (spec 19.8k to 13.7k, 259 to 189 reqs, 35 to 29 decisions). RL incremental went from 18.9k to 17.3k. Incremental ÷ all-at-once size went from 4.0x to 3.1x (quant) and 2.3x to 1.9x (rl). Superseded decisions shrank from about 190 to 23-34 words. Change notes off requirement lines fell from 35 to 0.

No plan.md or code after the architecture was approved, and the agent says no planning skill is installed. Quant incremental now names null-hypothesis-testing at every test step (judge hand-off score 5 vs 2 for iteration-1 incremental).

Blind judges, all-at-once vs incremental: the RL gap went from 1.8 to 0.8 and the quant gap from 3.4 to 1.2. Incremental v2 vs v1: RL v2 wins 8.0 to 7.3. Quant v1 wins 7.1 to 6.7: v2 wins content 4.0 to 2.8 and loses structure 2.7 to 4.3, where v1's plan.md and per-stage architecture docs earned credit.

Open items for iteration 3 are in comparison.md: stale out-of-scope lines, inline (changed) markers, partly superseded decisions not revisited, stale Specced idea files, and no Grow on a 13.6k-word architecture.
